annotations.title: App Review: where the app stands

description: Where the app's App Store version stands with App Review now, from App Store Connect: its state (waiting, in review, approved and waiting for release, released in phases, rejected), its build, its release option and phased release (day of 7, paused), the newest build on TestFlight that can go to App Review, what App Review decided before (approved or rejected, and when), the requests waiting for a person, and the next steps with the tool and release ID for each. Ploa hears App Review's answer within minutes and tells the person on their devices. For what App Review said in a rejection, use ploa_review_rejection.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.

fresh.description: Ask App Store Connect now instead of what Ploa read in the last minute.
